instanceoferror.description: An InstanceOfError occurs when an object used in a cryptographic operation does not match the expected type. CrySL rules enforce type constraints on cryptographic objects (e.g., a Cipher object might require a SecretKey, but a PublicKey is provided instead). This error prevents incorrect type usage that could lead to runtime failures, security vulnerabilities, or unintentional misconfiguration of cryptographic components.

examples.misuse: Depending on the parameters used during the initialization of the Cipher object (call to init) a specific algorithm has to be used in getInstance.
